title: Weapons
summary: Weapons fire automatically. You get them (and level them) from level-up choices and Manufacturer Arms boxes.

sections.title: Weapons
sections.note: Values by level are the numbers in the description (usually damage). Weight is how likely the weapon is to be offered on level up compared with the others (higher = more often). "EX" weapons exist only in the EX Edition.
rows: Snow White's exclusive weapon. Fires bullets to the nearest enemy. Deals 1 damage.
Mass-produced weapon modeled after Snow White's exclusive weapon. Fires bullets to the nearest enemy. Deals 1 damage.
Red Hood's exclusive weapon. Fires bullets in the direction faced and the opposite direction. Deals 1 damage.
Mass-produced weapon modeled after Red Hood's exclusive weapon. Fires bullets in the direction faced and the opposite direction. Deals 1 damage.
Scarlet's exclusive weapon. Swiftly unleashes a circular flurry of sword strikes. Deals 2 damage.
Mass-produced weapon modeled after Scarlet's exclusive weapon. Swiftly unleashes a circular flurry of sword strikes. Deals 2 damage.
Rapunzel's exclusive weapon. Spins on her own and creates an energy sphere. Deals 2 damage.
Mass-produced weapon modeled after Rapunzel's exclusive weapon. Spins on the wielder's own and creates an energy sphere. Deals 2 damage.
Dorothy's exclusive weapon. Rapidly fires bullets that can deal 1 damage. Fires at a wide range.
Mass-produced weapon modeled after Dorothy's exclusive weapon. Rapidly fires bullets that can deal 1 damage. Fires at a wide range due to the characteristics of the Submachine Gun.
Red Hood's secret weapon. Releases laser and deals 1 damage. Reloads slowly but is substantially destructive.
Sniper Rifle designed for shooting at large objects. Fires bullets and deals 30 damage. Reloads slowly, but significant damage can be expected.
Grenade used in the old times. Explodes shortly after being thrown and deals 2 damage.
Landmine set and used on the ground. Explodes shortly after being set up and deals 3 damage.
Semi-automatic Shotgun that fires multiple rounds of shotshells. Deals 2 damage.
Rocket Launcher that tracks and targets nearby enemies. Deals 2 damage.
Hexahedron that fires at nearby enemies and moves a certain distance before changing directions. Deals 1 damage to enemies.
Boomerang that spins like a vortex and strikes enemies. Deals 1 damage.
Missile that deals 4 damage. Fires upon receiving a signal of requesting artillery support to its vicinity.
Device that assaults nearby enemies. Deals 2 damage upon approach.
Exia's basic weapon. It sends out drones to her surroundings. After a brief wait, the drones charge rapidly toward the nearest enemies, dealing 1 damage before exploding.

Mass-produced weapon modeled after Exia's exclusive weapon. It sends out drones to her surroundings. After a brief wait, the drones charge rapidly toward the nearest enemies, dealing 1 damage before exploding.
Launches a spinning Sawtooth capable of penetration. It propels forward for a certain distance before returning, dealing 1 damage.
Fires a laser that seeks the nearest enemy and deals 1 damage. The laser will keep going until the target is destroyed.
Creates a robot that follows the character. A laser is produced between the robot and the character, dealing 3 damage while they move. When they're not moving, the laser deals 1 damage.

Fires a missile capable of penetration. After some time, the missile explodes and creates a black hole, absorbing enemies within a certain range of the explosion. The black hole deals 1 damage every 0.5 sec for 3 sec.
Fires pulse bullets capable of penetration. The pulse bullets move along a circular trajectory, dealing 1 damage and paralyzing enemies for 0.5 sec.
Launches sword energy alternately from the character's two sides, dealing 3 damage.

sections.title: EX. combined weapons
sections.note: EX Edition only. Holding both listed weapons at Lv. 5 lets a level-up turn them into the combined weapon (at most 3 per run).
rows: Sets up energy mines randomly around the character. Once set up, the mines deal 30 damage within a specific range.
A missile that launches a boomerang simultaneously as it explodes. It deals 30 damage upon exploding, while the boomerang flies in a helix formation and deals 30 damage.
An improved version of the Homing Laser. The laser rebounds 3 time(s), triggering a chain reaction and dealing 30 damage.
An improved version of the Plasma Sword. It launches sword energy in a certain pattern, dealing 30 damage.
A Pulse Gun that's an improved version of a Large Caliber Sniper Rifle. Despite its slow speed, it fires extremely large pulse and deals 45 damage.
A reflector incorporated with the pulse gun's paralyzing effect. While the reflector's duration has been reduced, it paralyzes enemies for 2 sec upon hitting them and deals 30 damage.
